lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
One who asks for a false gift,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kau marate ghaRee na laagai ||
lines.translation: shall not take even an instant to die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham jo sad hee sevai so gur mil nihachal kahanaa ||1||
lines.translation: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat jis kai man laagee ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship
sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: baah pakaR tis suaamee melai jis kai masatak lahanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||
His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.
Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa(n) kee dhooR nit baa(n)chhahi naam sache kaa gahanaa ||3||
lines.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||
Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau prabh hoi daiaalaa teraa keetaa sahanaa ||4||43||50||
lines.translation: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||
Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,
and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sache deen daiaal mere saahibaa sache man pateeaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sabad suhaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa guramatee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko meraa hau kis keraa ||
lines.translation: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.
The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: haumai kar kar jaai ghaneree kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai s har gun vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa kaa dar lekhaa sachai chhootas naam suhaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.
Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee mukate naam dhiaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||
The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.
Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: likhiaa lekh na metai koee guramukh mukat karaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||
In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.
Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: avagan muthee mahal na paae avagan gun bakhasaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. But through virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||
She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,
as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaak rahaae sachai naam samaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||
The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.
True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach kahai bena(n)tee sach milai gun gaavaniaa ||8||1||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1||
Maajh, Third Mehl, First House:
By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru.
